svg.title: CuNiFe S-Type STR26002 wiring reference
svg.desc: High-resolution wiring reference with Fender CuNiFe Stratocaster pickup roles, standard five-way functional contact map, neck-add SPST, rear-view volume and tone pots, treble-bleed topology, ten operating states, and common-ground checks.

g.text: MATCH IDENTICAL BOXED NET LABELS • FUNCTIONAL SWITCH CONTACTS MUST BE METERED
Electrical roles, not manufacturer lead colors
Functional contacts • throws overlap in 2 and 4
One pole supplies BUS. The other standard five-way pole is unused.
Find physical commons, throws, and overlap with a continuity meter.
ON: neck hot joins BUS in parallel.
OPEN → neck stays on blade throw 3 only
SPST common → BUS; other terminal → N-H.
In positions 4 and 5, ON adds no new pickup.
Contact view is functional, not a physical lug layout.
Treble bleed: (1,200 pF ∥ 150 kΩ) in series with 20 kΩ
BUS → parallel pair → TB-J → 20 kΩ → OUT
REAR VIEW • shaft away • lugs down
BUS feed works in every selector/switch state.
REAR VIEW • shaft away • lugs down
GND = all coil returns + separate shields/cases • volume CCW lug • 22 nF tone return • output jack sleeve.
Bond both pot cases, conductive switch chassis, cavity shielding, and bridge/string ground to the same ground network.
Identify pickup leads from Fender guide + meter; check phase in combined positions. Meter five-way overlap and SPST ON/OFF.
Tap-test all ten states; positions 4 and 5 should stay unchanged. Check clockwise controls, jack polarity, and cavity clearance.
Physical lead colors, switch lug order, and pickup phase are to be established on the actual parts.
